clauses.quote: Unit members shall receive the opportunity to volunteer for extra curricular assignments.
If assignments must be made, equity among the staff shall be a goal.
clauses.notes: Aspirational policy goal rather than a strict binding duty

clauses.quote: The list of both filled/unfilled assignments shall remain posted throughout the school year.
clauses.subject_text: The list of both filled/unfilled assignments

clauses.quote: The following assignments shall receive a factor equal to the stated percentage of each unit member's salary schedule placement: 8%—Project Coordinator, Audiologist, Music Technician; 4%—Psychometrist.
The following assignments shall receive a stipend equal to 5% of Class II, Step 5: Unit members credentialed and working in areas identified by the District as areas of critical shortage.

Teachers who are assigned to teach classes which meet the qualifications as contained in the "K-12 Program for LEP Students" adopted by the Board of Education on February 9, 1988, shall be compensated at the highest competency level expected and for which they are qualified.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who are assigned to teach classes which meet the qualifications as contained in the "K-12 Program for LEP Students" adopted by the Board of Education on February 9, 1988,

clauses.quote: Unit members with LDS Certificate as of April 12, 1988, shall remain at a stipend of $1,201.75 until the stipend of 3% exceeds that amount.
clauses.subject_text: Unit members with LDS Certificate as of April 12, 1988,
clauses.notes: Grandfathering provision for existing certificate holders

clauses.quote: Unit members who were "grandfathered" under the LDS program in 1984 will receive a stipend of 1%.
clauses.subject_text: Unit members who were "grandfathered" under the LDS program in 1984
